ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high local contrast at pigmentation boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous high-intensity white regions located medially on both lobes, bordered by solid black margins; the white region on the left lobe is bisected by vertical dark streaks, while the right lobe contains a single prominent diagonal dark streak.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate 90-degree aperture and well-defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged topography across the entire span; features a prominent secondary notch-like indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately two-thirds from the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edges transitioning to tapered, upward-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the distal tip of the left lobe; smaller punctate white spots visible on black trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear interruptions (rake marks) cutting through the high-intensity white regions; two vertical marks on the left lobe and one diagonal mark on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notch or tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe; significant barnacle colonization visible on the left tip.
